edition: Unofficial Zork Museum Songbird Correspondence Glulx

overrides.description: Add the physical songbird feather, reuse Zork's canonical bird nest, and add the Forest and Surface Life case, linked canonical-bauble evidence, and provenance plaque
Route the real feather into the forest case while keeping the canonical brass bauble in the trophy case and catalog both by actual custody
Retain every qualified Release 1239 layer, load songbird correspondence before museum intake, and assign Release 1240

player_outcomes: winding the real intact golden clockwork canary in a canonical forest room still produces the canonical brass bauble
the same authored event drops one real blue-black songbird feather beside that bauble
the player may physically carry the feather to the Living Room and EXHIBIT FEATHER in the Forest and Surface Life case
opening the canonical trophy case and using EXHIBIT BAUBLE moves the actual canonical treasure inside and preserves canonical scoring
the player may instead carry the feather to Up a Tree and PUT FEATHER IN NEST, permanently returning the same trace to Zork's existing bird nest beside the jeweled egg
CATALOG FOREST and READ SONGBIRD PLAQUE report the actual locations of the feather and brass bauble
taking either displayed object away immediately makes the linked exhibit truthful about what is absent
boundaries: no generic bird, nest, ecology, or specimen engine
no second nest and no duplicate brass bauble, canary, feather, or substitute specimen
no remote donation or abstract collection registry
no checklist of forest species or procedural wildlife
no replacement canary event or forest controller
no audit framework, recursive qualification machinery, or S.T.A.L.K.E.R. coupling
